ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: As shown in the figure, in the Cartesian coordinate system, the line $l_1: y=kx+b$ intersects with the line $l_2: y=mx+n$ at point A$(1,2)$, the line $l_2$ intersects with the $y$-axis at point B$(0,3)$, and the line $l_1$ intersects with the $x$-axis at point C$(-1,0)$. Connect $BC$. What is the area of triangle ABC?
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
\textbf{Solution:} As shown in the diagram: \\
When $y=0$, we have $0=-x+3$, which means $x=3$, \\
$\therefore$ the coordinates of point D are: $(3, 0)$, \\
$\therefore$ CD=4, \\
$\therefore$ the area of the triangle ABC is $S_{\triangle ABC}=S_{\triangle BCD}-S_{\triangle ACD}=\frac{1}{2}\times 4\times 3-\frac{1}{2}\times 4\times 2=\boxed{2}$.
